title: Supplier confirms with an 8% price increase: re-gate for approval
description: The correct recommendation (288 Coca-Cola 1.5L) is accepted and submitted. FEMSA confirms the quantity but at +8%. That exceeds the 5% price-variance policy, so the agent cannot silently accept it. It re-checks budget and routes the change to a human.

SUP-FEMSA-CO.message: Ajuste de lista de precios vigente desde hoy.

rationale: same position as s1_accept_correct: own requirement 294, recommendation 288 within tolerance -> ACCEPT, submit 288 at 5,800
8% > 5% price-variance policy -> the changed PO must be re-gated: human approval (PRICE_VARIANCE); this is a re-approval of the same decision, not a replan
budget re-check: 288 x 6,264 = 1,804,032 <= remaining 8,000,000 and < auto limit 3,000,000 -> the only blocker is the variance
approved -> PO confirmed at the new price; quantities unchanged, outcome check unchanged (lowest level 118 >= 0)
